<title level="1" right="Focus 3" pfs="Standard">
[Time Skip](/Spells.aspx?ID=1196)
<actions string="Single Action" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Uncommon" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=159" />
<trait label="Cursebound" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=320" />
<trait label="Focus" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=511" />
<trait label="Oracle" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=319" />
<trait label="Transmutation" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=157" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Dark Archive](/Sources.aspx?ID=129) pg. 189

**Mystery**
[Time](/Mysteries.aspx?ID=9)

<row gap="medium">

**Cast** [somatic](/Rules.aspx?ID=283)

 

</row>

<row gap="medium">
**Range** 30 feet

**Target** 1 willing creature other than yourself
</row>

<row gap="medium">

**Duration** 1 round
</row>

</column>

---

You manipulate time around your ally, pushing them forward a few moments in time. The target is [quickened](/Conditions.aspx?ID=32) on its next turn and can use the action only to Step, Stride, or Strike.

---
**Heightened (+1)** You can one additional willing creature other than yourself within range.
name: Time Skip
